decision: Retain as improved experimental working revision; not an accepted realistic teaching anatomy model. No further geometry change proposed in this review.
visibleImprovements: The new profile retains the clearer free anterior blade and descending posterior/inferior root relative to the frozen oval baseline.
The duplicated authored anterior roof remains removed and the gingival posterior fins remain reduced.
Interpolated source normals and broader smoothing soften the fine local corrugation beneath the blade while preserving the blade/root silhouette.
remainingVentralLimitation: A broad horseshoe-like ridge/recess remains visible beneath the anterior blade in the ventral and oblique clay views. Fine irregularity improved, but this region still reads as a designed transition rather than independently accepted mucosal anatomy. The field change has not established a fully convincing tongue surface.
otherLimits: Root/floor insertions and tissue transitions remain inferred; no genial/hyoid insertion validation.
The posterior roof/gingival volumes intentionally overlap; the dark cap seam is not proof of an anatomical air gap or welded continuity.
No medical, phonetic/tajweed or classroom acceptance. Successful technical checks are separate from perceived realism.

mechanicalResult.scope: Rest and three isolated tongue endpoints at jaw=0 only. No intermediate/combined controls, adjacent-fold/strain, contact biomechanics, phoneme or clinical/anatomical acceptance.

visualPoseScope: Native isolated/floor rest; sagittal jaw=.55 and diagnostic tongue endpoint images at jaw=.6. The independent GLB self test uses isolated tongue endpoints at jaw=0; these scopes must not be conflated.
comparisonLimits: Matching view directions, independent automatic framing. No calibrated size, pixel-IoU or medical-image agreement claim.
